name: Gokinjo Zukiai ~Rinjin Bijin Oyako Kousai~
original_name: ご近所ヅキ合い ～隣人美人母娘交際～
source:
A family just moved in next door.

The main character cannot help but be curious about the beautiful mother Naoko and daughter Erina.

After witness Naoko's shower, his thoughts become worse.

But Naoko is a married woman, and also much older than himself.

Although he is worried, they still meet each other everyday since they are neighbors, and become closer.

Helping with physical works, being invited for meals, and even looking over her daughter's studies.

The opportunity to go to her house also increase, the relationship deepens...!?

After that, what kind of "relationship" is it will be left to your choice!

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=848845]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
隔壁一家人刚刚搬进来。

主角不禁对美丽的母亲直子和女儿惠里奈感到好奇。

目睹直子洗澡后​​，他的想法变得更糟。

但直子是一个已婚妇女，而且比他自己年龄也大得多。

尽管他很担心，但作为邻居，他们还是每天见面，变得更加亲密。

帮忙做体力活，请吃饭，甚至监督女儿的学习。

去她家的机会也增加了，感情也加深了……！？

之后，是什么样的“关系”就交给你选择了！

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=848845]Getchu[/url]]
